title: XP and SAFe: what changes for the tester

videos.script: Scrum tells a team how to plan. It says nothing about how to write the code. Extreme Programming does. {{xp}} Write the test before the code. Program in pairs. Merge everything, and run every check, several times a day. Keep the build under ten minutes. {{practices}} Each practice is a loop of feedback, from seconds at the keyboard to months between releases. {{loops}} So what is left for a tester? The two things machines do badly. Helping the customer turn a rule into examples. And exploring, for the cases nobody wrote down. {{tester}} Then scale. With nine teams on one product, most failures happen between teams, where every team's own checks pass. {{between}} SAFe adds a System Team, and a demo of the whole product every iteration. Its classic trap is a hardening sprint, the waterfall's testing phase, back again. {{end}}
